title: Change an NPC
description: Renaming the greeter, bringing it over and turning its glow on

console: animus create greeter name=Greeter world=world x=-2.5 y=64 z=-9.5

beats.note: right-click with the wand opens its screen

beats.result: the greeter's screen in Simple mode
the nameplate reads Town Greeter; chat has the change with [Undo]

beats.note: six blocks east of the greeter, facing it along the open north road
the greeter is selected, so its screen opens

beats.result: Town Greeter stands two blocks in front of you, facing you
Advanced adds All fields and the other settings
All fields lists the greeter's settings by section

beats.note: back off so all of it and its outline show

beats.result: Town Greeter glows with a white outline

closing: Name renamed the greeter, Bring here moved it, and All fields turned its glow on
